تقتضبون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَضِبُونَ (taqtaḍibūna) /taq.ta.dˤi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# تُقْتَضَبُونَ (tuqtaḍabūna) /tuq.ta.dˤa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
